item.title: Reagans (Part 2)

item.title: Reagans (Part 1)
item.description: Ronald Reagan sets his sight on Washington, but the road to the White House will not be easy.

item.description: After inheriting the Frankenstein Castle, a doctor, who has tried all his life to distance himself from his notorious relative, finds himself drawn to the unfinished work.

item.title: The Fly
item.description: A mad scientist's invention leaves him forever changed.

item.title: The Abominable Snowman of the Himalayas
item.description: A kindly English botanist and a gruff American scientist lead an expedition to the Himalayas in search of the legendary Yeti.

item.title: How to Make a Monster
item.description: A make-up artist plots revenge against the studio that fired him.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: A girl mermaid is kidnapped by an octopus so the little boy mermaid goes to rescue her.
